The PR refactors Vydra image/video/speech media flows to reuse a resolved request policy for submit, polling, and generated-asset downloads while withholding configured headers from cross-origin assets.

PR surface: Source +66, Tests +43. Total +109 across 7 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: the image path supplies req.ssrfPolicy to its prepared policy while the changed video and speech paths do not. A focused guarded-fetch regression test is still needed to demonstrate the runtime divergence on the current head.

target.title: fix(vydra): apply request policy to media generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users routing Vydra media generation through configured request headers, a proxy, or private-network policy could have later polling or generated-media download requests leave that policy path even when the initial request succeeded.

## Why This Change Was Made

Vydra now resolves one prepared request policy and carries it through each applicable stage: image/video submit, poll, and download, plus speech request and download. Guarded fetches preserve the existing timeout/deadline and release contracts. Provider credentials and custom headers are included for same-origin assets, while cross-origin asset downloads remain free of those headers.

This is an AI-assisted contribution prepared for Alix-007.

## User Impact

Users and operators can rely on their configured Vydra headers, proxy dispatcher, and `allowPrivateNetwork` setting throughout a media-generation request. Cross-origin generated assets do not receive Vydra authorization or custom policy headers.

## Evidence

### Exact revision and CI

- Exact PR head: `f38357836d425c012a42e3b677f96c03eb57eb79`.
- Rebased onto known-green `main`: `7651ef5fca04f8263dd7f2d558d7c1425d60391e`.
- Current-head CI: [run 29379882930](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29379882930) completed successfully with 31 successful jobs, 12 path-skipped jobs, no failures, and no pending jobs.
- GitHub reports the PR mergeable; newer `main` commits have landed since the exact-green rebase.

### Controlled submit -> poll -> download proof

- A local Vydra-compatible loopback server was reached through a controlled HTTP CONNECT proxy using the real provider path and real `global fetch`.
- The observed video request order was exactly:
  1. `POST /api/v1/models/veo3`
  2. `GET /api/v1/jobs/job-local-video`
  3. `GET /generated/local-video.mp4`
- The proxy recorded three CONNECT tunnels to the same target, one for every stage.
- All three same-origin requests carried `X-Vydra-Policy: local-video` and the configured authorization header.
- The loopback flow exercised `allowPrivateNetwork: true`; the guarded request path requires that opt-in for the private target.
- A separate cross-origin image proof verifies that submit and poll receive the configured policy header while the generated-asset download receives neither authorization nor the custom policy header.
- The proxy harness closes accepted sockets, and production guarded responses retain `release()` cleanup in `finally` blocks.

Focused complete-chain proof:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/vydra/image-generation-provider.test.ts \
  extensions/vydra/video-generation-provider.test.ts \
  extensions/vydra/speech-provider.test.ts \
  extensions/vydra/provider-test-helpers.test.ts
```

```text
Test Files  4 passed (4)
Tests       20 passed (20)
Duration    44.74s
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 54.63s
```

Focused CONNECT-proxy proof:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/vydra/video-generation-provider.test.ts \
  --reporter=verbose \
  --testNamePattern="routes the full local Vydra-compatible video flow through the configured proxy"
```

```text
1 passed, 7 skipped
Target test: 213ms
Vitest duration: 13.95s
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 20.22s
```

Crabbox/Testbox was attempted first, but the selected binary failed its basic `--version`/`--help` sanity checks. The repository-approved narrow local `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs` fallback was therefore used and is reported here explicitly.

### Static checks and review

- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check` on all seven touched files: all files correctly formatted.
- `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` on all seven touched files: exit 0.
- `git diff --check 7651ef5fca04f8263dd7f2d558d7c1425d60391e..HEAD`: passed.
- Fresh autoreview was attempted with Codex first; that engine returned HTTP 401. Claude Sonnet 4.6 with high reasoning was used as the required fallback. One accepted test-coverage finding was fixed and reverified; remaining findings were checked against the request types, guarded SSRF implementation, and Undici proxy source. No accepted actionable findings remain.

### Remaining proof boundary

No live Vydra account, external proxy, TLS route, or real generated Vydra media artifact was exercised. The proof is controlled local HTTP behavior through the production provider and guarded-fetch paths, not a live-provider claim.
